Mini-B features a wide zoom, ranging from 4° to 55° that makes this little luminaire extremely versatile. At the narrow angle, the beam produced is very solid and concentrated, superb for aerial effects. At full aperture, the Mini-B becomes an excellent wash light and it can replace much heavier and bulkier equipment. The Mini-B's central LED may be controlled separately from the external ring of LEDs, making it ideal for graphic lighting effects too. More than fifty pre-installed effects/color macros, 2500K-8000K color temperature control, a 24 bit dimmer with five curves, an electronic strobe @ 25 f/sec, and Ethernet access complete this highly professional tool.
